title: with-timeout only fires at wait points

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: `with-timeout' checks its deadline when Emacs waits for external events; CPU-bound Lisp that does not wait can run past the deadline.
hypothesis: A body that calls `sleep-for' should return the timeout form, while a short busy loop should run past the deadline and return normally.
minimal_fixture: Two short timed forms: one waiting with `sleep-for', one CPU-bound loop guarded by an outer wall-clock limit.
predicted_behavior: Timeout behavior differs at wait points versus CPU-bound work.

independent_checks.name: busy loop ran past timeout and returned normally

counterexample: In-Emacs timeouts cannot be the only watchdog for model actions or package code that can loop without waiting.
derived_gym_requirement: The gym supervisor needs an out-of-process watchdog, and operation results must distinguish failed, canceled, and outcome_unknown.
